meta.subject: DCache MSHR probe request missrspin hit in same cacheline fixed

en.summary: Fixes a DCache coherence hazard where a probe for a cache line collides with a returning miss response for the same line, and the cache must stop admitting new core requests during that overlap.
why_it_counts: The patch changes central DCache and MSHR control logic in the line-fill and probe path.
It introduces an explicit same-line probe-versus-miss-response hazard state instead of treating the overlap as a normal secondary access.
The fix prevents new core traffic from entering the cache while the line is simultaneously being probed and refilled.
evidence: L1MSHR.scala adds missRspprobeReqSameBlock by comparing probe and miss-response block addresses, plus ASID when MMU is enabled.
L1MSHR.scala drives mshrStatus_st0 to 4 when a valid miss response overlaps a same-block probe.
DCache.scala adds mshrStatus_st0 != 4 to stage-0 request acceptance so io.coreReq.valid and io.coreReq.ready are blocked during that overlap.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: This fix protects a cache line when two control flows touch it at once: a miss response is returning data for the line while a coherence probe for that same line is also being processed. A correct design must treat that overlap as a special hazard window and stop accepting new requests that could observe or modify the line before probe and refill ordering is resolved. Without that guard, the controller can transiently treat the line as available even though ownership and returned data are in flight at the same time.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: same-line probe and refill conflict handling
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A coherence probe targets a cache line in the same cycle or hazard window that a miss response for that line is returning to the cache.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove the special conflict classification and allow the cache front end to keep accepting requests as if the overlap were an ordinary secondary-access case.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: drop conflict predicate and front-end stall term
portability_notes: Map this to any cache or cache model that can receive both refill traffic and coherence probes for the same line.
The essential bug is not the exact numeric state encoding; it is the absence of a dedicated hazard outcome for probe-plus-refill overlap.
If the DUT has separate tag, data, and MSHR control, apply the mutation where same-line probe/refill detection feeds request admission or replay control.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that detects when a probe address matches a line that is currently being refilled or returned from miss handling.
Change that logic so the overlap no longer raises a dedicated hazard or stall condition.
Remove the corresponding request-admission gate so stage-0 or front-end requests are still accepted during the overlap window.
Keep all other miss/probe handling unchanged so only the missing conflict guard is reintroduced.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DataCache stage-0 request gating and L1MSHR same-block probe/miss-response detection
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit adds missRspprobeReqSameBlock in L1MSHR, maps that case to mshrStatus_st0 == 4, and then blocks DataCache request enqueue/ready when that status is present.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Undo the missRspprobeReqSameBlock-based status-4 assignment in L1MSHR and remove the corresponding mshrStatus_st0 == 4 exclusion from DataCache request admission.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A core request can enter the cache while a same-line probe and refill are colliding, leading to incorrect hit/miss handling, transient coherence ordering errors, or corrupted same-line state transitions.
evidence_for_injection: The new wire missRspprobeReqSameBlock is computed directly from probe and miss-response block addresses.
The patch creates a previously absent status value specifically for that overlap case.
The DCache front end explicitly learns about the new status and blocks both valid and ready on it.
notes: If another DUT does not expose an MSHR status bus, inject the bug by removing whatever same-line probe/refill conflict signal feeds request backpressure.
Reverting both the detector and the front-end stall most faithfully recreates the original bug.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 DCache 的一致性冲突：当同一 cache line 的 probe 与 miss response 返回重叠时，缓存必须在该窗口内停止接收新的 core 请求。
why_it_counts: 补丁直接修改了 line fill 与 probe 路径上的核心 DCache/MSHR 控制逻辑。
它把同一 line 上的 probe 与 miss-response 重叠定义为专门的 hazard 状态，而不是普通 secondary access。
修复后的逻辑会在 probe 与 refill 并发处理期间阻止新的 core 流量进入缓存。
evidence: L1MSHR.scala 新增 missRspprobeReqSameBlock，通过比较 probe 与 miss-response 的 block 地址，在启用 MMU 时还比较 ASID。
L1MSHR.scala 在有效 miss response 与同 block probe 重叠时把 mshrStatus_st0 置为 4。
DCache.scala 新增 mshrStatus_st0 != 4 的门控，使 io.coreReq.valid 和 io.coreReq.ready 在该重叠窗口被拉低。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 这个修复保护的是同一 cache line 上的双重控制事件：miss response 正在把该 line 的数据返回到缓存，同时一致性 probe 也命中了该 line。正确设计必须把这种重叠视为专门的 hazard 窗口，并停止接收可能提前观察或修改该 line 的新请求，直到 probe 与 refill 的先后关系被妥善处理。若缺少这个保护，控制器会在所有权与返回数据同时在途时，错误地把该 line 当作可用。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 同一 cache line 的 probe 与 refill 冲突处理
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 一致性 probe 命中某条 cache line，且同一周期或同一 hazard 窗口内该 line 的 miss response 正在返回。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 去掉这个专门的冲突分类，让缓存前端继续把该重叠当作普通 secondary-access 情况处理。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除冲突判定并移除前端停顿项
portability_notes: 把该缺陷映射到任何既可能接收 refill 流量又可能接收 coherence probe 的缓存或缓存模型。
关键问题不是具体的状态编码数字，而是缺少 probe 与 refill 同 line 重叠时的专门 hazard 结果。
如果 DUT 分离了 tag、data 与 MSHR 控制，应在 same-line probe/refill 检测馈入请求接收或 replay 控制的位置注入该缺陷。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到检测 probe 地址是否命中当前正在 refill 或 miss-return 的 cache line 的逻辑。
修改该逻辑，使这种重叠不再触发专门的 hazard 或 stall 条件。
删除对应的请求接收门控，让 stage-0 或前端请求在重叠窗口内仍能被接受。
保持其他 miss/probe 处理逻辑不变，只重新引入“缺少冲突保护”这一行为。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DataCache 一级请求门控与 L1MSHR 同 block probe/miss-response 检测
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该提交在 L1MSHR 中新增 missRspprobeReqSameBlock，并把该情况编码为 mshrStatus_st0 == 4；随后在 DataCache 中用该状态阻止请求入队和 ready。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 回退 L1MSHR 里基于 missRspprobeReqSameBlock 的状态 4 赋值，并删除 DataCache 请求接收路径上对该状态的排斥条件。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 当同一 line 的 probe 与 refill 冲突时，core 请求仍可能进入缓存，导致 hit/miss 判定错误、瞬时一致性顺序错误，或同 line 状态转移异常。
evidence_for_injection: 新增加的 missRspprobeReqSameBlock 直接由 probe 与 miss-response 的 block 地址比较得到。
补丁为该重叠场景新增了之前不存在的专用状态值。
DCache 前端明确读取这个新状态，并在该状态下同时阻止 valid 和 ready。
notes: 如果另一 DUT 没有显式 MSHR 状态总线，可以直接删除 same-line probe/refill 冲突信号到请求反压路径的连接。
同时回退检测逻辑与前端停顿逻辑，最接近原始缺陷。
